description: Defines a class KeyWords that maps Symbol enum values to string representations and vice versa, used for parsing or serializing document symbols in the MigraDoc library.

classes.name: KeyWords
classes.description: Provides static mappings between Symbol enum values and their string representations, including methods for conversion.

methods.name: SymbolFromName
methods.description: Returns Symbol enum value from a string name, with case-insensitive fallback for true/false/null.

methods.name: NameFromSymbol
methods.description: Returns string representation of a Symbol enum value.
